items.title: VI Live: Olise is wéér de aangever bij Franse dominantie
items.summary: Tijdens het WK 2026 in Canada, Mexico en de Verenigde Staten volgt Voetbal International alle 104 duels in een eigen VI Live. In deze editie alle aandacht voor Frankrijk en Zweden. In aanloop naar en vanaf de aftrap om 23.00 uur blijf je volledig op de hoogte van dit duel.

items.title: Topscorerstrijd op volle toeren: ook Mbappé is Klose voorbij
items.summary: De topscorerstrijd op dit wereldkampioenschap is razend spannend. Nagenoeg alle sterren geven thuis en geen record lijkt veilig. Waar Miroslav Klose nog als topscorer aller tijden het toernooi inging, is hij inmiddels gedegradeerd tot nummer drie.

items.title: KNVB zoekt nieuwe bondscoach: 'Weten dat er enige haast bij geboden is'
items.summary: De KNVB heeft Ronald Koeman bedankt voor zijn bijdrage als bondscoach van het Nederlands elftal. De voetbalbond is inmiddels begonnen aan een grondige evaluatie, waarin ook wordt gekeken naar wie de nieuwe bondscoach van Oranje moet worden. Daar is enige haast bij geboden.

items.title: Bielsa stapt op als bondscoach van Uruguay
items.summary: Marcelo Bielsa houdt ermee op als bondscoach van Uruguay. Na het teleurstellend verlopen wereldkampioenschap van de tweevoudig kampioen, heeft de excentrieke coach besloten zijn taken erbij neer te leggen.

items.title: Koeman resigns, while Netherlands report racist abuse
items.summary: Ronald Koeman resigns as Netherlands manager after their World Cup exit, which led to "appalling" racist abuse aimed at players who missed penalties.

items.title: Quiz! Tien vragen over ex-bondscoach Ronald Koeman
items.summary: Bondscoach Ronald Koeman is opgestapt bij het Nederlands elftal . Hij werd met Oranje uitgeschakeld in de zestiende finale van het WK, door Marokko. We staan stil bij het bondscoachschap van Koeman met tien quizvragen.

items.title: Defying logic - how Haaland could end up with 260 international goals
items.summary: Erling Haaland delivers on the biggest stage yet for Norway - but just how many goals could he end up with in international football?

items.title: Forest Green Rovers scrap women’s team to ‘concentrate resources’ on men’s side
items.summary: Men’s team relegated to National League in 2024 Club hope women’s football will return in future Forest Green Rovers have disbanded their women’s team for the 2026-27 season so that they can “concentrate their resources” on trying to return their men’s team to the English Football League. The Gloucestershire club’s women’s side finished second in their regional division of the fifth tier of the English pyramid last term, narrowly missing out on promotion to the fourth tier by one point behind the champions, Torquay. They lost just one league match across the season. Continue reading...

items.title: Haaland the late hero as Norway knock out resilient Ivory Coast
items.summary: Manchester City striker Erling Haaland scores a late winner as Norway beat Ivory Coast 2-1 to book their place in the last 16 in the 2026 World Cup.

items.title: Erling Haaland fires Norway into last 16 with dramatic winner against Côte d’Ivoire
items.summary: Decision vindicated. The Norway coach, Ståle Solbakken, had taken a major gamble in resting almost his entire side in the final group game against France, drawing stiff criticism, not least from those who had paid hundreds of dollars to witness a showdown between Erling Haaland and Kylian Mbappé. As Solbakken said, the decision would stand or fall on the result of this game. Norway are in the last 16, players and fans celebrating with a communal Viking row led by Martin ­Ødegaard, and therefore his policy can be considered justified. Continue reading...

items.title: Quansah and James miss England training as right-back problems mount
items.summary: Jarell Quansah and Reece James miss training as England's right-back issues mount before their World Cup last-32 match against DR Congo on Wednesday.

items.title: Tottenham win race to sign West Ham’s Mateus Fernandes for club record £85m
items.summary: Spurs beat Manchester United to signing of midfielder Fernandes due to have medical before completing deal Tottenham are poised to break their transfer record after beating Manchester United to the signing of Mateus Fernandes for £85m. The Portugal international is heading for a new challenge after West Ham’s relegation from the Premier League and will strengthen Roberto De Zerbi’s options in central midfield. De Zerbi, who helped Tottenham to narrowly avoid relegation last season, has been handed significant funds this summer and also hopes to sign the Newcastle midfielder Sandro Tonali. Continue reading...

items.title: Spurs agree £85m deal for West Ham's Fernandes
items.summary: Tottenham agree a deal to sign West Ham's Mateus Fernandes as Manchester United pull out of the race for midfielder.

items.title: Plan to expand Africa Cup of Nations from 24 to 28 teams is rejected
items.summary: Executive committee member says it was ‘very bad idea’ Caf says its aim is to make tournament world class A plan to expand the Africa Cup of Nations from 24 to 28 teams has been rejected, the Guardian has learned. The proposal had been made by the Confederation of African Football’s president, Patrice Motsepe, in February at a press conference in Dar-es-Salaam in Tanzania. Had it been agreed it would have been put in place for the 2028 tournament. Continue reading...

items.title: Rangers sign Pandur from Hull as Butland nears Tigers move
items.summary: Rangers have signed goalkeeper Ivor Pandur from Hull City in a £6m deal.

items.title: Garcia fails to qualify for Open; Nicholas leads Burnham & Berrow
items.summary: Sergio Garcia says he fell ill during qualifying for The Open, hindering his chance of qualifying for the tournament next month. James Nicholas qualifies by finishing top of the leaderboard in Burnham & Berrow.

items.title: Haaland scores late winner to set up Norway vs Brazil
items.summary: Erling Haaland scored an 86th-minute winner to send Norway to a dramatic 2-1 win over Ivory Coast - and set up a mouth-watering World Cup last-16 clash with Brazil.

items.title: Battling Serena suffers Wimbledon defeat on much-anticipated return
items.summary: Serena Williams suffered defeat to Maya Joint in her much-anticipated return to Wimbledon following a four-year absence after an epic battle on Centre Court.

items.title: Garcia rues lasagne after missing out at Final Qualifying - who progressed?
items.summary: Former Masters champions Sergio Garcia and Danny Willett both failed to earn a spot at The 154th Open through Final Qualifying, as YouTube sensation Wesley Bryan also narrowly missed out.
